disposition_mapping.rationale: Document assembly becomes deterministic orchestration (not an agent) inside the matching core, resolving PO revisions and partial receipts, with an explicit incomplete-vs-variant distinction the council converged on as both an operational and a KB-09/KB-02 evidentiary requirement. A named assisted-retrieval fallback preserves the function where automated connectivity or licensing cannot reach an entity, per the emerging-economy and buildability concession all members accepted in round 2.

Quantity-vs-GRN comparison is deterministic arithmetic with no judgment content to protect, so the council unanimously accepted removing it as a standalone human-attributed step. It survives as a distinct, separately typed, separately traceable sub-computation within T1, retaining goods receipt note data as a required input per TWM-R-01/TWM-R-03 and KB-05's requirement that an error be correctable to its specific source.

Price/terms-vs-PO comparison is likewise deterministic and non-judgmental, and is merged into T1 as a separately typed sub-computation, retaining purchase order data as a required input per TWM-R-02/TWM-R-04, so that root-cause diagnosis and correction (price vs quantity) remain possible without re-running the match.

Tolerance classification is mechanical rules evaluation and is merged into T1, but the council required two survivals beyond the mechanics: the tolerance policy itself (TWM-R-05/R-06) continues to be consumed and evaluated, and (per KB-06 and the HITL designer's hold) a named human policy owner remains accountable for calibrating and periodically re-approving the versioned table, which is captured per match so policy drift across periods is visible rather than silent.

The council rejected the maximalist's default-agentic-resolution model by a clear majority (pragmatist, finance_domain, emerging_economy, hitl_designer, agentic_architect, accounting_standards), grounded in KB-04/KB-05: a genuine discrepancy is a candidate accounting error, and its correction must terminate in an accountable human write, not an agent disposition reviewed on a confidence basis. Timing gaps are split out as a distinct deterministic requeue sub-function (finance_domain's correction, adopted by the whole council), since an absence is not a variance and cannot be expressed as a tolerance band. What survives requeue remains human-decisioned, optionally assisted by a read-only, write-free, evidence-citing agent with a shown reliability record (agentic_architect's and hitl_designer's architecture), satisfying TWM-R-10 and TWM-R-05's spirit without permitting liability laundering.

Full council consensus: routine, clean/tolerance-passed matches release through a deterministic, reversible, fully logged gate with no human in the loop, since that approval was already ceremonial in the baseline. Non-routine releases (exception-resolved items and overrides) retain a human approver of record, now routed by delegation-of-authority rather than a flat role per finance_domain, with execution-cadence honesty (real-time vs batch) per emerging_economy, and with full evidentiary access rather than a bare verdict per hitl_designer and accounting_standards. This satisfies TWM-R-07 and, combined with T2's distinct actor, TWM-R-08 (ordering) and TWM-R-09 (segregation of resolver and approver).

The council rejected the maximalist's telemetry-replaces-reporting design by near-unanimous vote, grounded in KB-03: a continuous stream has no period boundary and cannot substitute for a signed, period-tied artifact. Continuous append-only logging is retained as a genuine, cheap improvement, but the AP accountant continues to prepare and sign a periodic report, now required (per finance_domain, emerging_economy, hitl_designer and accounting_standards) to include GR/IR clearing account aging and reconciliation as a named output tied to KB-01/KB-11 accrual discipline, and override detail at vendor/category/approver granularity rather than aggregate-only statistics.

steps.actor: Deterministic matching and rules engine (system-executed), with AP analyst exception-queue monitoring and a named tolerance-policy owner; assisted/manual retrieval fallback for unsupported entities
steps.description: Deterministic orchestration (no inference, no model) retrieves PO, GRN and invoice data, resolving PO revisions and partial-receipt tranches, and runs a data-quality pre-check (UoM consistency, duplicate vendor flags) before computing typed, separable quantity and price/terms variances and evaluating them against a versioned, externally-owned tolerance policy table. Output is a three-state assembly status per line (complete-and-matched, complete-and-variant, incomplete) so that a missing document is never silently folded into a variance verdict; incomplete sets route to requeue (T2), not to the exception queue directly. Tolerance policy sophistication (flat or tiered) may match what the organisation can actually govern, but every match record captures the exact policy version applied, and the policy table itself has a named human owner accountable for its periodic calibration and re-approval. Where automated retrieval cannot reach a plant, vendor master, or entity due to licensing, integration or connectivity gaps, assembly routes to a named, logged assisted-retrieval fallback queue rather than degrading silently. This function gates payment release, not recognition: the liability is already recognised on receipt regardless of match outcome.
steps.name: Automated match execution and tolerance evaluation
outputs: Assembled match document set with completeness status (complete-matched, complete-variant, incomplete)
Price and terms variance detail (PO-sourced, separately typed)
Match classification (clean, tolerance or exception) with tolerance policy version recorded

steps.actor: AP analyst (sole disposition-writer), supported by a deterministic requeue scheduler and an optional read-only, write-free evidence-assembly agent
steps.description: Incomplete-document-set flags and timing-pattern variant signatures (missing GRN against a known open PO, pending credit memo matched by vendor/amount/reference) first pass through a deterministic, bounded requeue: a scheduled retry against structured ERP state for a defined cycle count or hold period, which is deferral, not resolution, and requires no judgment. What survives requeue is a genuine discrepancy. The AP analyst investigates this residual population against source documents and vendor correspondence and remains the sole party with write authority over the disposition (accepted, corrected, or rejected). Where locally validated, an optional read-only agent may retrieve vendor-master data and historical resolution precedent and draft a suggested disposition with shown reasoning, cited source evidence and its own measured agreement rate against this organisation's historical dispositions; the agent has no ledger-write access and must return an explicit 'insufficient evidence, escalate' output rather than a low-confidence suggestion dressed as routine. The analyst's interface requires engagement with the underlying evidence, not a one-click accept of a bare verdict. The resolution and its full evidentiary basis are retained as a distinct, retrievable artifact.
inputs: Vendor correspondence and historical resolution precedent (where locally validated)
steps.name: Requeue and human-decisioned exception resolution
outputs: Exception resolution evidence (decision rationale, cited source documents, agent suggestion and reliability record if used)

steps.actor: Deterministic release gate (system-executed) for routine matches; AP supervisor, or delegated procurement/budget-owner approver per delegation-of-authority routing, for non-routine releases
steps.description: Clean and tolerance-passed matches release through a deterministic, fully logged gate, with no human in the loop, and with a tested reversal path allowing claw-back before the payment run; execution cadence (real-time or next batch window) is stated honestly against the organisation's actual payment-run infrastructure rather than implied as uniformly instant. Exception-resolved items and tolerance overrides route to a human approver of record, with release authority assigned by delegation-of-authority tables so that overrides exceeding an AP supervisor's limits escalate to procurement or the budget owner rather than being approved outside real authority; a documented maximum turnaround governs cross-border or cross-timezone delegation, with a named escalation action on timeout. Whichever human approves a non-routine release must see the full resolution evidence and the resolver's stated reasoning, not merely the resolver's verdict, so the segregation between resolution and release is a real independent check, not a label.
steps.name: Tiered release authorisation

steps.actor: AP accountant (periodic report preparer and signer), with system-generated continuous event logging
steps.description: Every event from T1 through T3 — match outcome, requeue cycle, resolution evidence, release action, override, and tolerance policy version applied — writes to an append-only control log as it occurs. This continuous log supplements, but does not substitute for, a periodic, period-tied report that the AP accountant prepares and signs, because cutoff discipline requires a defined-period artifact rather than an on-demand query against a stream. The periodic report surfaces override rates and patterns by vendor, category and approver at a level the preparer can actually interrogate, not aggregate-only statistics, and includes GR/IR clearing account aging and reconciliation as a named output tied to the accrual position behind unmatched or unresolved items.
steps.name: Continuous control logging and periodic signed control reporting
outputs: Periodic signed match-rate, override-pattern and GR/IR aging reconciliation report
